title: Create: Dynamic Village — village building file
description: One custom building injected into a village pool. Place at data/<namespace>/dynamicvillage/buildings/<name>.json.

pool.description: Target template pool, e.g. minecraft:village/plains/houses. Any pool works.

structure.description: NBT structure id (loaded from data/<ns>/structure/<path>.nbt). Needs a jigsaw block at its entrance.

weight.description: Share relative to other custom buildings in the same pool. 0 disables (removes a default).

processors.description: Processor list id to apply to the structure.

conditions.description: Optional load conditions; ALL must be met or this building is skipped.
